title: Watch
summary: Watches a list of sources for new and changed items and writes one report per run, even in a quiet week.

stages.title: Read sources
stages.does: Opens each source and lists items dated inside the lookback window, up to max_items.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write the report
stages.does: Writes the report, then updates the seen list last.

connectors.label: Web fetch
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run can already open web pages.
